entries.title: Creator pages are expanded with yt-dlp --flat-playlist instead of a gallery-dl crawl
entries.retire_when: gallery-dl can print one item URL per post without resolving download URLs

entries.title: iwara.ai is pinned to gallery-dl because yt-dlp's Iwara extractor only matches iwara.tv
entries.retire_when: yt-dlp's iwara extractor matches iwara.ai; the pin then becomes engine=yt-dlp

entries.title: Locale tube hosts are rewritten to the bare domain before yt-dlp sees them
entries.retire_when: the site extractor matches a two-letter locale subdomain

entries.title: YouTube uses yt-dlp's native downloader: aria2c opens -x connections per DASH fragment
entries.retire_when: aria2c stops multiplying connections per fragment - re-measure a 900 MB DASH video

entries.title: YouTube click-tracking cookies (ST-*) are dropped on export
entries.retire_when: yt-dlp filters click-tracking cookies itself, or YouTube stops setting ST-*

entries.title: A yt-dlp verdict needs a final file on disk (a zero exit is not a download)
entries.retire_when: yt-dlp exits non-zero, or verifies its own merge, when only fragments remain

entries.title: n.sfw.video uses yt-dlp's generic extractor; the description works but the uploader is not exposed
entries.retire_when: yt-dlp has a dedicated n.sfw.video extractor that exposes the author; add %(uploader)s/ (display name, not the handle) to the template and file the existing videos into author folders, inside each drive
